meta.name: abp-ddd
meta.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4/10.5) Domain Driven Design: Entity, AggregateRoot, repository, domain service, application service, DTO, domain events (AddLocalEvent/AddDistributedEvent), specification, value object, UOW. Use when designing the domain layer, entities, aggregates, or repositories in ABP.

copy.tagline: 用ABP框架设计领域驱动架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在ABP项目中需要DDD指导
copy.tagline_en: Design domain-driven architecture with ABP framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need DDD guidance in ABP projects

howto.what: 当用户要求设计 ABP 领域层时，Claude 会提供实体、聚合根、仓储、领域服务、应用服务、DTO、领域事件等的代码示例和设计建议，严格遵循 ABP v10.x 的 DDD 模式。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ABP 实体”、“聚合根”、“仓储”等关键词，或要求进行 ABP 领域驱动设计时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 ABP 实体类 Book。
设计一个 ABP 聚合根 Order，包含子实体 OrderLine。
编写一个 ABP 应用服务 BookAppService，包含 CRUD 操作。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to design the domain layer in ABP, Claude provides code examples and design advice for entities, aggregate roots, repositories, domain services, application services, DTOs, domain events, etc., strictly following ABP v10.x DDD patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like 'ABP entity', 'aggregate root', 'repository', or requests ABP domain-driven design.

say_en.text: Create an ABP entity class Book.
Design an ABP aggregate root Order with child entity OrderLine.
Write an ABP application service BookAppService with CRUD operations.
